assumptions: All six seedling records are authored fictional data, not real measurements or predictions. A1–A3: start4, end10/11/12cm; B1–B3: start4, end7/8/9cm over seven days. Gains6/7/8 and3/4/5; means7 and4.

Weak/strong refer to relative light intensity; exposure duration is held similar. Variety, age, starting condition, pots, soil, timing and method are comparable; important actual conditions are monitored. Random assignment and replicates improve interpretation, not certainty.

Matching watering plans does not establish equal soil moisture. Light intensity may change moisture/temperature; actual conditions need monitoring. FairTestLab flags only three listed confounders and produces no growth outcomes.
Chart uses common zero-based0–10cm axis and raw-table-derived values; no statistical significance, health, mass, sugar or daily rate inference.

Additional pale-leaf and slender-stem records are fictional qualitative clues. Placeholder green before reveal is not a measurement. Low-light elongation is a possible mechanism, not unique diagnosis.

S01 original virtual scene provides appearance and habitat clues only; species names, diets and abundance changes are not established. Five record fields are checked for structure only; child/family reviews scientific content.
